summary: Related pack (features lattice/turns/verify, claims 67609c19-de05-862c-8db7-e5dc95f38cee..008, 82fa5163-847a-8bb4-9cf4-61c3fb607187/014, prior be53dde7-0211-8c72-aeae-43494a57c198 UI trail, docs work-model/episodes) shows the bet is directionally right (4f850c5a-83ce-85c9-a081-b0a3e02d2811 + path coverage + cheap align JSON) but several high gaps before seal: missing client/server in featureIds vs real UI/hook blast, expectedPaths/treeDigest not on schemas yet, waiver abuse, and cheap-model false-approve without a structured checklist. Worktree scan caution-only (no sibling dirty entries).
plainSummary: The plan was not ready to seal: coverage, skip, and schema holes would have made the gate unenforceable.

findings.gap: Acceptance and 82fa5163-847a-8bb4-9cf4-61c3fb607187 rely on slice expectedPaths[], but schemas/workstream.json suggestedSlices has no expectedPaths field and no graph→path ownership table beyond node.locator. Without that, 'covered by spec at every path' is untestable and agents will invent ad-hoc rules.
findings.plainImpact: You could not tell which files a slice was allowed to touch, so coverage would be guesswork.
findings.fixProposal: Add optional expectedPaths: string[] (globs ok) on suggestedSlices in schema + 76451749-a54f-8579-96f2-dcec19d79026 slices for packages/ui/**, packages/ledger/src/{audit,turns,reviews}/**, scripts/git-hooks/** before seal; document coverage algorithm in work-model.md one paragraph.

findings.gap: featureIds are [lattice, turns, verify] but related prior turn be53dde7-0211-8c72-aeae-43494a57c198 (same Lattice surface) touched client + server packages and claim 14d9b121-df2b-8ede-bce7-fdee648a4320/b69a663d-e2dd-8655-be45-0e07bfb45c89. Hooks/CI and FileDiff live under ui; align CLI may touch client HTTP. Omitting client/server understates blast and starves path coverage via graph locators.
findings.plainImpact: The plan would ignore client and server packages that the UI already changes.
findings.fixProposal: Extend featureIds to include client and server (or add explicit expectedPaths covering packages/client and packages/server for cd25a530-33a4-8e92-aad7-1f07c3e8fa79/04). Update primaryFeatureId only if lattice remains the hero.

findings.gap: afbad76d-e486-8108-9e2c-231bfc254ab8 and cd25a530-33a4-8e92-aad7-1f07c3e8fa79 require code approve bound to treeDigest, but schemas/review.json has no treeDigest (or waiver) property. writeReview() only supports turn-scoped files; workstream/spec reviews are hand-written paths. Risk: treeDigest stuffed into untyped findings.evidence → weak gate.
findings.plainImpact: Approves could not be bound to a real tree, so the gate would be unenforceable.
findings.fixProposal: Before seal, amend acceptance to require schema+CLI changes in cd25a530-33a4-8e92-aad7-1f07c3e8fa79: review.treeDigest?: string; optional waiver collection schema; listSpecReviews helper. Do not seal implying the field already exists.

findings.gap: correctnessCritical + cheap Haiku-class align agent can rubber-stamp approve. Acceptance says 'asks user for coverage intent' but does not require a machine-checkable checklist (uncovered path count == 0 OR waiver ids listed) inside the approve JSON. Free-text summary alone fails f92f85de-1e99-855b-b750-225f42af5f81 spirit.
findings.plainImpact: A cheap reviewer could rubber-stamp coverage with a free-text note.
findings.fixProposal: Require approve reviews to cite killers or structured fields: uncoveredPaths: [] and coverageSource: user|graph|expectedPaths; refuse approve when uncoveredPaths non-empty unless waiver ids listed. Skill must say: cheap model fills checklist; user confirms coverage intent.

findings.gap: allowExplicitAlignSkip: true without constraints — a one-line waiver nullifies the whole gate. No min reason length, no severity, no audit failOn for naked waivers, no 'who' distinct from builder required in acceptance.
findings.plainImpact: A one-line skip could turn the whole coverage gate off.
findings.fixProposal: Acceptance: waiver requires reason (>= N chars), actor, treeDigest, workstreamId; audit warns/fails on waiver without reason; policy.alignSkipMaxPerTurn default 1. Silence still ≠ skip.

findings.gap: Bet correctly keeps verify.ok claims-pure, but 654cc896-be04-8523-bb8b-a64161d0e665 'CI job runs the same check' could be mistakenly folded into pnpm verify. Related 67609c19-de05-862c-8db7-e5dc95f38cee/a642f738-2313-853e-a94d-d9936dcbc596 already separate audit vs verify — acceptance should name the script (e.g. pnpm ledger:align or audit --fail-on align) explicitly.
findings.plainImpact: CI might mix coverage into claim verify and break the claims-only report.
findings.fixProposal: Name the CI step and npm script in acceptance; state verify workflow remains untouched.

findings.gap: 8e34ebbd-c0cb-888c-95b8-0eaf07ecb634 absorbs large uncommitted UI polish already in the working tree (plan-first turns, density, FileDiff) that was implemented under done beee03a2-1e8d-8091-9ed9-b35bea93d6a3 without a new turn — related be53dde7-0211-8c72-aeae-43494a57c198 treeDigestDrift already true. Seal without a residualRisk note invites repeating 4f850c5a-83ce-85c9-a081-b0a3e02d2811 breach mid-build.
findings.plainImpact: Uncommitted UI work could land without an open turn on this bet.
findings.fixProposal: Add residualRisks: orphan UI diff must land only after seal under open T-00x for 76451749-a54f-8579-96f2-dcec19d79026 8e34ebbd-c0cb-888c-95b8-0eaf07ecb634; no further product UI until turn open. Optionally list current dirty UI paths in an attachment.

findings.gap: Acceptance 'skills/AGENTS instructions tell any host to use cheap model' is not e2e-checkable evidence. Without a committed skill file path in acceptance, hosts will ignore it.
findings.plainImpact: Hosts would not be told to use a cheap align model or ask for coverage intent.
findings.fixProposal: Name artifacts: skills/sl-dev-align/SKILL.md + AGENTS.md bullet; evidence = path exists + mentions Haiku/cheap model and user coverage ask.

findings.gap: worktreeCautions from related: scan is caution-only string, not structured sibling entries — residualRisk for multi-worktree agents remains soft.
findings.plainImpact: Other worktrees would stay a soft warning, not a hard stop.
findings.fixProposal: Copy into residualRisks; do not block seal on this alone.
